title: The Last Lantern
author: Dot Nova
introduction: A storm is swallowing the harbor of Bellwake. Its lighthouse has gone dark, and the last ferry is approaching the reef. Bring any character you can imagine. Describe how they act; the same three-stat rules govern every approach.

circumstances.name: A glimpse of the keeper’s chart

sections.title: The Empty Quay

prompts.heroic: The ferry carries people who need your help. You set out to relight the tower.
prompts.villainous: The harbor council offers a fortune to whoever restores the light. You intend to collect.
prompts.chaotic: A storm, a dark tower, and an audience on a ferry: this promises a memorable entrance.

sections.obstacle: The causeway is flooding. Find a way across before the next wave.

success.text: You cross dry-footed and glimpse a useful maintenance chart.

failure.text: A wave knocks you into the reeds. You survive, soaked, but the direct route is gone.

sections.title: The Broken Span

prompts.heroic: A dockhand is stranded beside the broken bridge. You refuse to leave them behind.
prompts.villainous: A dockhand knows where the reward is kept. Their information is worth a detour.
prompts.chaotic: The dockhand’s disbelief at your arrival is delightful. Now for a bigger surprise.

sections.obstacle: The last stretch of bridge falls away. Reach the tower entrance.

success.text: You secure a route to the tower and arrive with a brass access token.

failure.text: The span gives way. You reach a lower ledge, forced to find another entrance.

sections.title: Through the Reeds

prompts.heroic: A frightened marsh creature shows you a sheltered route when you approach gently.
prompts.villainous: The marsh creature’s trail may save precious time and preserve your claim to the reward.
prompts.chaotic: The reeds echo every noise. You turn the confusion into a spectacular diversion.

sections.obstacle: Find the tower through flooded channels before the rising water closes them.

success.text: You find the service hatch above the waterline.

failure.text: You claw back to the quay. The ferry is closer; you must try again.

sections.title: The Keeper’s Hatch

prompts.heroic: A weary keeper calls through the jammed hatch. You offer reassurance while working it open.
prompts.villainous: The keeper can validate your reward claim. Opening this hatch serves you both.
prompts.chaotic: You announce yourself through the hatch with theatrical confidence. The keeper is baffled.

sections.obstacle: Open or bypass the hatch without losing your footing.

success.text: The hatch opens and the keeper passes you a glowing reserve spark.

failure.text: The ledge crumbles. You scramble back onto the bridge, empty-handed.

sections.title: Inside the Lantern Tower

prompts.heroic: You hear the ferry bell. Every moment you save may protect someone aboard.
prompts.villainous: The promised reward feels almost within reach. You will not surrender it now.
prompts.chaotic: Your shadow fills the stairwell. This is the perfect place for a dramatic ascent.

sections.obstacle: The spiral stair is broken. Reach the lantern chamber above.

success.text: You reach the lantern chamber as the ferry enters the outer channel.

failure.text: A collapsing step sends you back toward the service hatch. You survive but must approach again.

sections.title: The Last Light

prompts.heroic: You picture the people aboard the ferry and commit everything to guiding them home.
prompts.villainous: You picture the council paying your reward and commit everything to claiming this victory.
prompts.chaotic: You picture every face turning toward your impossible light and commit to the grand finale.

sections.obstacle: Restore the beacon before the ferry strikes the reef. This is a Finale with a Fatal failure.

success.text: The beacon blazes. The ferry turns clear of the reef. Bellwake will remember the stranger who brought back its light.

failure.text: The chamber collapses before the light catches. Your adventure ends in the storm. You may retry from your checkpoint or begin again.
